patches.title: Patch 084 // FAIRY ENGLISH VOICE FACTORY DEFAULT
patches.notes: Configure Language starts in English (en-US) for new installations, including spoken responses and Edge-TTS voice. Microphone prioritizes English, and PT-BR/ES remain options. Existing language selections and the manual Reboot language requirement are unchanged.

patches.title: Patch 083 // LANGUAGE DEFAULT & UI CONSISTENCY
patches.notes: Language consistency: fixes mixed English/Portuguese captions, boot messages, update statuses and session logs; logs retranslate when changing language. New Fairy installations default their interface to English independently of the voice or microphone languages. Existing explicit UI choices remain unchanged.

patches.title: Patch 082 // FAIRY CONSOLE-FREE SETUP
patches.notes: Fix unwanted black Python terminal windows while installing or configuring Fairy. Language, AI providers, Fish Audio and advanced settings launch with pythonw.exe. The Fairy factory installer now hides nested pip, venv and Playwright consoles. Installation progress remains visible in H.D.D. itself.

patches.title: Patch 081 // FAIRY MAINTENANCE RECOVERY
patches.notes: Fairy Management maintenance repaired: confirmation buttons instead of typing phrases; scoped Fairy shutdown, optional force-close approval, cache lock diagnostics, safe factory backups with rollback, and reliable Windows Recycle Bin fallback. Original Fairy project is never affected.

patches.title: Patch 080 // WINDOWS STARTUP + FIRST FAIRY REBOOT
patches.notes: New Windows Startup settings: H.D.D. off by default, Fairy on after successful first Reboot; both independent. Reboot runs once per Fairy installation. Later starts launch Fairy directly without the cinematic. Existing Fairy activations are recognized. Resets/uninstalls remove startup entries.

patches.title: Patch 079 // System-Wide Language Repair
patches.notes: Fixes mixed English/Portuguese text in Diagnostics, live System Monitor, Storage Analysis, Protocols, settings messages and update history; improves PT-BR/Spanish switching and preserves file paths.

patches.title: Patch 078 // Explorer: Large Icons + Fullscreen
patches.notes: File Explorer now supports F11 fullscreen, large icons with async image thumbnails, folder navigation, persistent view mode, and wider filenames in details view.
